title: The Quiet Minute
origin: Original fiction, thematically linked to workbook Q8, not a verbatim adaptation.

setup.line: The next room booking is soon. Theo keeps one hand on the night-walk plan.

setup.speaker: Theo
setup.line: Main gate, courtyard, then the harbour. Everyone happy?
Ellis lowers a pencil. Another route stays folded.

setup.speaker: You
setup.line: We haven’t heard the whole route yet.

choice.prompt: How will you hear the room?

round.speaker: You
round.line: One concern each. No replies until we’ve gone around.

round.speaker: Nia
round.line: The gate will be shut. We need to reach the courtyard first.
Theo starts to answer, then leaves the speaking token with Nia.

round.speaker: Ellis
round.line: Mine starts here. But we’d lose the harbour.
The next group knocks. The harbour is still unfinished. Every seat now faces part of the route.

slips.speaker: You
slips.line: Put down the concern you haven’t said. Then we’ll sort them together.
Gate closure. Crowding. A different start. Theo adds a sketch too.

slips.speaker: You
slips.line: Then we leave the courtyard out?

slips.speaker: Nia
slips.line: Not cancel the courtyard. Go there first.

slips.speaker: You
slips.line: Thank you. I read that too quickly.
Nia points to the courtyard. The route almost fits. One slip remains unclear.
